info.name: BPCC Real-Time Statistics API
info.description:
With the Bright Pattern Contact Center Real-Time Statistics API, you can currently do the following:

  • Create and manage a real-time statistics subcription

  • Retrieve dispositions

  • See if agents are available for a specified service

Notes:

  • Users attempting to use this API must have the privileges "Access Realtime Stats API", "View real-time agent metrics", and "View real-time service metrics" enabled, as well as be the assigned supervisor for the corresponding teams.

  • For a list of statistics to use, please see Bright Pattern Contact Center Help Documentation.

item.description:
Authentication

This API supports authentication via OAuth 2.0.

OAuth 2.0 Authentication

The OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials Grant is used to authenticate clients of this API, using the Get Access Token method. The authenticated user is checked for having appropriate privileges to perform the requested operation. The complete list of privileges can be found here. Privileges are assigned to users via one or more Roles.

To obtain an access token:

  1. Login to your BPCC configuration portal.

  2. Navigate to the Users page.

  3. Select or create a user; the user must:

    1. Have the following privileges:

      • Access Realtime Stats API

      • View real-time agent metrics

      • View real-time service metrics

    2. Be assigned as a team supervisor (i.e., they will get metrics for agents of this team and services handled by this team)

  4. Click the Generate button to generate an API secret key. Copy the generated key and note the username for the next steps.

  5. Use the Get Access Token method to obtain an access token. Set the client_id to the above username and the client_secret to the generated API secret key. A successful response returns an access_token:

{
  "access_token": "<access token value>",
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": "3600",
  "scope": "yourcompany.brightpattern.com"
}
  1. Use the value of access_token in the Authorization header of each subsequent request made via the BPCC Real-Time Stats API:
Authorization: Bearer <access token value>

Basic Authentication (Deprecated)

Note: This authentication method is deprecated since the release of the User Authentication service. Requests to Authenticate (POST /statsapi/auth) will return a 403 Forbidden response with {"error": "illegal login attempt". Use OAuth 2.0 Authentication instead.

Basic authentication authenticates a user on a server using the Authenticate method. In the case of successful authentication, the server sets session cookies.

The authentication token retrieved by the Authenticate method must be included in the Cookie header of other methods:

Cookie:X-STATSAPI-TOKEN=61XXXXX2-XEX5-4XBX-81C3-14CXXXXXX721; X-STATSAPI-TENANT=tenant_URL; X-STATSAPI-LOGIN=user.name

Note that this cookie is valid until the next user logs into any wallboard (i.e., one cookie per user).

item.name: Methods

request.description:
This method creates a subscription for a specific set of metrics. Each client can have only one active subscription.

Response Codes

Code Description
200 OK subscription was created
400 Bad request
401 Unauthorized
409 Limit of active subscriptions exceeded for tenant

This method gets the statistics data of an active subscription.

Note:

  • Your user must be the supervisor of a team in order to retrieve agent_grid information.

Response Codes

Code Description
200 OK
204 No content (data is not ready yet)
401 Unauthorized
404 Bad request (there is no active subscription)

response.name: Get Subscription Data

request.description: This method deletes the active subscription, and clears the data cache on the server.

This method gets the disposition names for all supervised services.

Optional URL Parameters

  • agentCanSelect = 1

  • inbound = 1

  • outbound = 1

  • preview = 1

Response Codes

Code Description
200 OK
401 Unauthorized

request.description:
This method gets either the "true" or the "false" value for agents ready to handle a specific service.

Note:

  • No authentication or subscription is needed for this method.

Response

Code Description
200 OK
True "Number of ready agents" > 0 for the specific service (i.e., at least one agent is available)
False "Number of ready agents" is 0 for the specific service (i.e., no agent is available)

This method returns the names and internal object IDs of teams configured for the given tenant.

Note that in order to get the above information about a specific team, the account used for API authentication must be assigned as a supervisor to that team.
